name: mastermind-scheme-double-preparation-no-agility-below-eight
notes: Mastermind Scheme (9lbewemius, NORM slow action, printed reserve 6): "[Class Bonus] Efficiency (This card costs LV less to activate.) Double the amount of preparation counters on your champion. Then if there are eight or more preparation counters on your champion, you gain agility 3 for this turn." The champion is patched to Tristan, Hired Blade (level 2, ASSASSIN) with 3 preparation counters. Efficiency makes it cost 6 - 2 = 4 reserve payments (4 cards in memory); the ability doubles the counters to 6, which is below eight, so no agility.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Efficiency: this card costs LV less to activate.
Double the amount of preparation counters on your champion.
(With fewer than eight counters after doubling, no agility 3.)
